faqs.a:
(a)
This article being necessary to secure the public health, safety, convenience and
               welfare, it shall be liberally construed to effect its purposes.
(b)
Nothing in this article shall be construed to limit to the procedures specified in
               this article, the city's ability to impose assessments for the construction of public
               improvements on benefited properties, provided the city has established alternative
               procedures by ordinance.
(Code 1981, § 27-3; Ord. No. 551, § 3, 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 2553, § 1, 9-6-1988)
